_note: Niche matrix from roadmap.txt section 3. 'weight' drives brief selection; stock_smm.py multiplies it by observed sales to bias future batches. Weights need not sum to 1 — they are normalised at pick time.

niches.name: b2b_saas_ui
niches.style_hint: flat vector, limited palette, crisp geometry, generous whitespace, no gradients heavier than two stops

niches.name: industry_infographics
niches.style_hint: flat isometric or straight-on infographic, numbered steps, consistent stroke weight, muted corporate palette

niches.name: regional_cultural
niches.style_hint: symmetrical geometric ornament, flat two-to-four colour, clean repeating motif, no photographic texture

niches.name: occupational_flat
niches.style_hint: flat character illustration, simple shapes, no facial detail beyond basic features, consistent proportions

niches.name: packaging_dielines
niches.style_hint: line-art or two-tone stamp, precise strokes, high contrast on transparent ground, print-ready simplicity

niches.name: abstract_geometric
niches._weight_note: Very high demand but high competition — deliberately down-weighted so the engine does not drown in the most crowded category.
niches.style_hint: bold flat shapes with at most simple linear gradients — heavy blur and mesh gradients do not vectorise cleanly, prefer crisp geometry
